CRS line confirms value projects. Omitting out_sr keeps layer’s native CRS; point, line, polygon layers use API. Records without geometry remain projects. Make subset locations plot: Draw city boundary context, add case locations: city-boundary layer adjusted follow shoreline. provides map context, legal survey boundary.
code: # Request one CRS for both layers so their coordinates can share a map. projects <- get_dataset(   "development-cases",   spatial = TRUE,   out_sr = 4326 )  # Only the boundary ID is needed; spatial = TRUE still returns its geometry. boundary <- get_dataset(   "city-boundary",   fields = "OBJECTID",   spatial = TRUE,   out_sr = 4326 ) # Check the CRS reported for the case locations. sf::st_crs(projects)$epsg # Preserve projects; create a plotting subset with nonempty geometries. mapped_projects <- projects[!sf::st_is_empty(projects), ] # Draw the polygon first so it forms a backdrop for the case locations. plot(   sf::st_geometry(boundary),   col = "#EDF4F6",   border = "#7898A5",   lwd = 1.2,   axes = TRUE,   graticule = TRUE,   col_graticule = "#DCE7EB",   xlab = "Longitude",   ylab = "Latitude",   main = "Active development cases in Tampa" )  # Filled circles have separate outlines and translucent fills. if (nrow(mapped_projects) > 0L) {   case_fill <- grDevices::adjustcolor("#E76F51", alpha.f = 0.7)   plot(     sf::st_geometry(mapped_projects),     add = TRUE,     pch = 21,     bg = case_fill,     col = "#9B4934",     cex = 0.85   )    # Match the legend symbol to the plotted points.   graphics::legend(     "bottomleft",     legend = "Development case location",     pch = 21,     pt.bg = case_fill,     col = "#9B4934",     bg = "white",     box.col = "#DCE7EB",     cex = 0.85   ) }
